question: 56 years ago today, Gordie Howe became the first NHL player to reach 1,000 career assists. Which of his NHL seasons was he playing at the time?
question_short: Gordie Howe was the NHL's first player to 1,000 assists. Which NHL season was he in?
answer_detail: Howe was 42 and in his 25th straight season with Detroit (1970-71). He still wasn't done: he later played six WHA seasons and came back to the NHL at 51 with Hartford.
answer_short: Howe was 42, in his 25th Detroit season, and later returned to the NHL at 51.
